title: Out of memory: what ComfyUI tries first
hook: An out of memory error means ComfyUI already tried several things. Know what it tried, and you know what's left for you to change.

verified.claim: VAE decode and encode catch out of memory, log a warning, and retry with tiles.
A VAE with a reliable estimate goes straight to tiles.
ImageUpscaleWithModel halves its tile from 512, and raises the error below 128.
The VAE's attention and split cross attention have their own retries.
When OOM reaches the engine it adds a tip, logs a memory summary and unloads all models. The message and tip were produced by a test node raising OutOfMemoryError.
The sampler runs conds together only if 1.5 times the estimate is free.
The formula for minimum_inference_memory and maximum_vram_for_weights.
get_tiled_scale_steps gives 9, 7, 7 at tile 64 overlap 16, which are decode_tiled_'s defaults, and 9, 5, 5 at overlap 8, which is what VAEDecodeTiled's defaults become on an 8x VAE.

unchecked: We didn't exhaust a real card for this lesson. The fallback paths are read from source, and the lab simulates the decisions.
Dynamic VRAM changes how models load, and --lowvram's help says it does nothing when dynamic VRAM is on. We didn't trace the dynamic path in detail.
The advice on RAM, fragmentation and packs holding on to tensors is general experience. We didn't measure it here.
We found no OOM retry in comfy/samplers.py itself, by searching it. A retry deeper in a model's own code would not show in that search, beyond the attention one we list.
